Resolves #20282

Unifies `Neo.component.Splitter`, `Neo.main.draggable.Resize`, and `Neo.dashboard.dock.interaction.DockSplitter` minimum-size resolution across nested multi-sibling container trees and conserved-pair split boundaries. `Splitter#getSiblingMinSize` and `hasSiblingMinSize` recursively aggregate descendant bounds (`Math.max` across perpendicular `vbox`/`hbox` splits, `sum` + internal splitters across parallel splits, and active-card floors for `TabContainer`/`card` containers) while ignoring `minWidth: 0` / `minHeight: 0` flex-shrink resets and preserving `oppositeId` discovery for non-numeric CSS minima (`var()`, `calc()`); `Resize#createState` honors `minSize` and `counterMinSize` inside `[1, pairTotal - 1]` on conserved-pair (`counterTargetId`) descriptors; and `DockSplitter#getResizeConfig` preserves `Math.max(1, config.minSize || 0)` on edge rails while forwarding `minSize` and `counterMinSize` on split boundaries.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite in Node single-thread simulation + main-thread Resize DOM harness) → L2 required (all four ACs on #20282 are `[L2-unit]`). Residual: none.

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline pre-commit lint (12/12) + unit suite (73/73) ran`
